title: The bakery that stopped taking Thanksgiving on paper
variant: Magazine feature: serif columns broken by pull quotes
prompt: A case study of a neighborhood bakery that added online ordering for holiday pre-orders.
note: Magazine feature on a warm brown-50 ground: a centered serif title and standfirst, body text in serif at two columns, and three large serif pull quotes at full width that break the columns, each attributed to a role over a short brand rule. Results are told in words with the caveats inline rather than as a strip, because the shop measured almost nothing and the page refuses to invent the figures; the before/after pair is two short matched columns in one bordered card, the lessons are a ruled two-column serif list, and the apply-this box is brown-tinted so the only brand green on the page is in the kickers, the rules, and the check marks.
